response.sql: WITH owned_accounts AS (SELECT DISTINCT disp.client_id, disp.account_id FROM disp WHERE disp.type = 'OWNER'), district_counts AS (SELECT a.district_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS client_count FROM owned_accounts AS oa JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = oa.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY a.district_id, d.A3), total AS (SELECT SUM(client_count) AS client_count FROM district_counts) SELECT dc.region, AVG(dc.client_count) AS average_clients_per_district, AVG(1.0 * dc.client_count / total.client_count) AS average_district_share FROM district_counts AS dc CROSS JOIN total GROUP BY dc.region
